services.name: Parasailing - Kona
services.desc: Parasailing flights from Kailua-Kona with options up to 1,200 ft, including a dip in the water and panoramic coastline views. An Out of This World Experience!

blurb: UFO Parasail offers parasailing experiences where guests can fly alone, tandem, or three at a time, enjoying panoramic views of the Pacific and Hawaiian islands. Parasailing is easy, fun, and suitable for guests aged 5 and up. They also offer sport fishing, whale watching tours, and banana boat rides.

quotes.author: Claude P. • Tripadvisor
quotes.text: This is a seriously fun activity. But the team at UFO made it so much better. If you haven't parasailed before, this is the team you want. Their instructions were calm, confident and simple. Their execution was flawless. Most of all, they really know what they are doing and have a lot of fun doing it.

quotes.author: Kelly M. • Tripadvisor
quotes.text: The crew was absolutely amazing! Our ride was incredible. Super smooth going out and coming back in. Since it had been my birthday a few days prior, the crew gave us a few 'birthday dunks' prior to coming back into the boat. I cannot say enough good things about this crew and the trip!

quotes.author: Amanda A. • Tripadvisor
quotes.text: If you’ve been thinking about parasailing ? do it! I was super nervous about it. Ty and I believe his name was Cory did an amazing job! Super fun and professional!! They totally made the experience much better! Thanks guys ?

quotes.author: Jodi A. • Tripadvisor
quotes.text: My daughter and I had a great time flying. We ended up being the only ones on the boat. The people that took us know made us fell safe even thought the water was rough. It was so fun would do it again.
